decision_rationale: No genuine archived paired rotation origins or mature paired outcomes were found in the canonical stores inspected, and no independently approved numeric horizon mapping exists in the pinned governance chain. Outcomes needing a prebound horizon cannot supply their own initial horizon. Calendar and endpoint gaps independently prevent complete replay. Tooling and descriptive windows do not close this structural bootstrap.
